Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Before this sale, somebody on the team asked “Hey, what if we combine some of the new cards with some of the Chaos Vault cards? Can we do that? Is that even allowed?” We all stopped in our tracks and said, “The boss is gone. You’re in charge now.” Then we couldn’t remember who actually had the idea first, so after some discussion, we all agreed to share acting manager duties. But after a few days, we realized we don’t like being boss. So we’re all going back to our old jobs. Nevertheless, this collection of green, white, and blue cards is a perfect starting bundle for building your next Bant commander deck. It’s maybe the best thing we ever did as interim boss.
Contents:
• 1x Garden Buds Foil Edition
• 1x Fairest Drop of All Foil Edition
• 1x Tome of the Astral Sorceress
• 1x Strange Sands – Plains
• 1x Strange Sands – Forest

When purchasing this unique product, please keep in mind that this Secret Lair Drop Series Sealed Product will ship out to you after the seller receives the product directly from Wizards of the Coast.

The estimated time frame for sellers to receive stock is not fixed, so it could be anywhere between 1 - 10 weeks for delivery.
